pixel_findings: Fresh direct original-resolution pixel inspection completed for all 14 actual-GLB v004 renders, three locked reference images and the 1080x1920 comparison-phone board. No pass was assumed from builder notes or the prior review.

Source identity is retained: red terracotta Deco frontage, paired large arched windows, two-level narrow central slots, stepped crown, dominant vertical blade, projecting gold/red marquee, illuminated soffit and grouped lobby doors.

C3-P0-01 is closed. Both marquee stay upper ends now meet visible dark mounting plates on solid masonry outside the arched openings. facade_close and front_corner show their lower ends meeting the canopy side structure; the pane fields remain uninterrupted.

C3-P1-01 is closed. top and aerial show the left roof outline stepping inward near the rear portion. rear_side proves the corresponding full-height envelope return and ground contact, rather than a roof-only cosmetic notch.
All elevations are completed with opaque auditorium walls, regular side pilasters, two doors per side and a rear service door. The setback does not create an exposed interior or dangling corner.

The pitched roof lantern has framed panes, closed gables and a seated curb. Four roof-service units have visible pads and duct contacts. The raised rear volume closes cleanly. No triangular lighting patches recur.

Blade lettering and crown are separated; GRAND and CINEMA occupy marquee fields clear of the central and end finials. Sign support relationships remain visible in architecture_close. The blade is correctly edge-on in true front view and readable from side/oblique views.
Lobby glass_close proves handles, frame/pane depth, interior counter and floor, with seated entry steps. arched_glazing shows mullions and interior depth; no stay pierces the glazing.
No building vegetation programme is delivered or implied. Source street context is excluded. Restrained colour clay is coherent without invoking textured PBR keeper criteria.
Whole-building cameras retain neutral margins. Detail cameras make entrance optics, arches, sign, marquee and roof contacts inspectable. The phoneboard matches the individual v004 evidence.
